plan.text:
Add three focused regression tests to PricingCalculatorTest.java that pin down the existing bulk-discount threshold in DiscountPolicy.discountRate (subtotalCents >= 10_000 -> 10% discount) for a REGULAR-tier order: 9,999 cents (no discount), 10,000 cents (discount applies), and 10,001 cents (discount applies). No production code changes are needed.

Implementation steps:
1. Confirm threshold logic: DiscountPolicy.discountRate() returns 0.10 when subtotalCents >= 10_000 for CustomerTier.REGULAR, else 0.0; PricingCalculator.calculateTotalCents rounds subtotal * (1 - discountRate).
2. In /src/test/java/com/sweforge/pricing/PricingCalculatorTest.java, add three @Test methods following the existing style (single Order built via List.of(new Item(...)), assertEquals(expected, calculator.calculateTotalCents(order))).
3. Case 1 (9,999 cents, below threshold): build an order whose items sum to 9,999 cents, e.g. new Item(9_999); expect no discount so expected total = 9,999.
4. Case 2 (10,000 cents, at threshold): build an order summing to 10,000 cents, e.g. new Item(10_000); expect 10% discount so expected total = 9,000.
5. Case 3 (10,001 cents, just above threshold): build an order summing to 10,001 cents, e.g. new Item(10_001); expect 10% discount so expected total = 9,001 (10_001 * 0.9 = 9000.9, rounds to 9001).
6. Name the new tests descriptively per existing convention, e.g. subtotalJustBelowThresholdHasNoDiscount, subtotalAtThresholdGetsBulkDiscount, subtotalJustAboveThresholdGetsBulkDiscount.
7. Do not modify DiscountPolicy.java, PricingCalculator.java, or any other production source file.
8. Run the relevant tests: mvn -Dtest=PricingCalculatorTest test (Java 21) and confirm all cases pass, then optionally run the full mvn test per repository convention.

Validation:
- All three new tests pass, confirming 9,999 -> no discount, 10,000 and 10,001 -> 10% discount (rounded).
- Existing tests (smallRegularOrderHasNoDiscount, largeRegularOrderGetsBulkDiscount, vipOrderGetsVipDiscount) still pass unmodified.
- Diff shows changes only in PricingCalculatorTest.java; no production code files (DiscountPolicy.java, PricingCalculator.java, Item.java, Order.java, CustomerTier.java) are modified.
- mvn test completes successfully for the whole module.
